title: Machine learning-guided single-cell multiomics uncovers GDF15-driven immunosuppressive niches in NSCLC: A translational framework for overcoming anti-PD-1 resistance
summary: The full text describes harmonized survival modeling across four NSCLC immunotherapy cohorts (156 patients), single-cell analysis and external melanoma-cohort evaluation, followed by functional experiments; it distinguishes predictive association from preclinical mechanism. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
